text:
mike-sales: FYI we kicked off the NovaPay enterprise POC this morning. Customer seeing big spikes in first-token latency around 300–500ms and occasional 503s when they hit concurrency ~40. Can we swarm? cc @anya-eng @devin-eng @elaine-solutions
anya-eng: on it. do we have logs/trace ids? also any rate-limit headers from their requests?
devin-eng: asking for a sample trace now. Mike, can you paste a request id and the exact time window?
mike-sales: pasted: request_id=rp_20231024_09:13:45; seen from their side around 09:13–09:18 UTC. they also shared a short header dump:

--headers--
X-Request-Id: rp_20231024_09:13:45
X-Rate-Limit-Limit: 2000
X-Rate-Limit-Remaining: 0
X-Rate-Limit-Reset: 1698101400
User-Agent: NovaPay-Connector/1.4
--end--

sam-support: X-Rate-Limit-Remaining=0 explains the 429 -> but they reported 503s too, maybe queue overflow/timeout after throttling.
elaine-solutions: customer is running many short prompts with streaming enabled; they have an internal fanout that sends parallel calls per user session. sounds like bursts.
infra-liz: quick check: our runtime logs show a short period of shard queue saturation at 09:14:10–09:15:30 UTC on pool gpu-pool-3. sample log snippet:

[2023-10-24T09:14:12Z] ERROR serve: queue timeout after 120s for shard=3 req=rp_20231024_09:13:45 status=503
[2023-10-24T09:14:12Z] WARN  batching: batch_size 48 > batch_window_target 30ms, flushing early

infra-liz: also seeing lots of cache-miss churn on the prefix cache — miss_rate ~ 72% during the spike.
anya-eng: that aligns with batching + bursty parallelism. two quick mitigations we can try now: 1) lower client concurrency (client-side) or add jitter, 2) reduce batch window target to 10ms on their route or set max_batch_size=16 so batches don't grow huge.
devin-eng: adding: enable per-route short-circuit for small inputs (prefer immediate single-item exec) and set route config: 
```json
{
  "route": "novapay-prod",
  "max_batch_size": 16,
  "batch_window_ms": 10,
  "streaming": true
}
```

mike-sales: can we flip that on for their test route quickly? they'll try another ramp in 10 mins. also they asked about SLA/pricing if we need to move them to dedicated capacity.
elaine-solutions: for Dedicated we can offer reserved pool size to match their concurrency SLAs; rough ballpark: 4x reserved GPUs for sustained 200 rps, we should send a tailored quote. I'll draft.
security-jordan: quick note on blockers: customer asked for KMS/HSM details and IP allowlisting. we need to confirm deploy mode for Private/Dedicated and provide SOC2/HSM docs. Mike, I'll need their security questionnaire back by EOD to unblock contracts.
ops-bot: Incident note: created incident INC-20231024-007 for shard saturation; assigned to infra-liz and devin-eng.
infra-liz: temporary patch pushed to reduce batch_window to 12ms for novapay-prod route. monitoring dashboards show queue depth dropped 70% within 1 minute.
devin-eng: we also turned on response-prefix caching at the route level (ttl 60s) to reduce identical-prefix re-computation; cache hit improved from ~28% -> ~61% after ramp down. still watching for eviction churn.
anya-eng: follow-up for next test: ask NovaPay to reduce parallel fanout from 6 -> 2 per session, keep per-connection pacing at ~50ms. that plus our batch_size cap should keep TTFT under 120ms median.
mike-sales: during the trial they asked about burst credit pricing — can we offer a small burst buffer (on top of reserved) for free for the first 30 days? Elaine will propose.
elaine-solutions: noted, will include a 30-day burst allowance in the quote and mark as trial concession.
security-jordan: also: send the KMS/HSM architecture doc and an allowlist template. I'll attach the SOC2 summary.
sam-support: final check: no more 503s after the patch but they still saw some 429s right at the reset window. recommend they spread ramping across a minute otherwise rate headers will trip.
devin-eng: agreed. next actions: (1) Elaine to send quote + burst concession (2) Security to send docs & questionnaire template (3) Mike to coordinate new ramp with NovaPay after config change (4) infra/dev to monitor for 1 hour and report metrics. owners assigned above.
mike-sales: thanks team — I'll schedule a 20m sync with NovaPay at 09:40 UTC to run the next ramp. will update here after the run. :thumbsup:
